summary: Authority-guard + real-offer preservation — Backend 7/7 PASSED in 29.88s. Admin logged in (admin@negobuy.ai), created mission 'Authority Guard Chairs' (qty=500, budget=450000 INR → max_authorized_unit=900), discovery returned a vendor within 75s. (1) POST /api/missions/{id}/vendors/{vid}/negotiate {rounds:2} → 200; GET /api/missions/{id}/offers contains an ai_negotiation_preview offer for this vendor with fields within_authority (bool), status, and max_authorized_price==900. In this run the simulated vendor settled <=900 → within_authority=true and status='OPEN' (as expected per agent-to-agent note; forcing OUT_OF_AUTHORITY is non-deterministic and acceptable to skip). (2) POST /api/missions/{id}/vendors/{vid}/outreach/apply-offer {price_per_unit:820, lead_time_days:12} created a source='vendor_email', simulation=false offer. Re-running POST negotiate {rounds:1} kept the SAME vendor_email offer (same id, negotiated_price=820) — server.negotiate's delete_many is correctly filtered by source='ai_negotiation_preview' and does not wipe real offers. (3) No auto-commit: mission status stayed pre-approval (not APPROVED/COMPLETED); no purchase auto-created for this mission at /api/missions/{id}/purchases or /api/purchases. (4) Regression: /api/system/status 200, /api/dashboard/analytics 200, /api/vendors/memory 200. Test mission cleaned up in teardown.
critical_code_review_comments: server.negotiate (lines 302-333): authority hardening looks correct — within_authority flag, status OPEN/OUT_OF_AUTHORITY, max_authorized_price persisted; delete_many is source-filtered to 'ai_negotiation_preview' only, so vendor_email/manual real offers are preserved across re-negotiations. Verified via test.

outreach.apply_offer (line 166) still does an UNFILTERED db.offers.delete_many({mission_id, vendor_id}) — meaning applying a real email offer will wipe any existing ai_negotiation_preview for that vendor. That is likely desired ('real supersedes preview'), but note the asymmetry: negotiate is source-scoped, apply-offer is not. Consider documenting this precedence rule.

Forcing status='OUT_OF_AUTHORITY' is non-deterministic under the current simulated vendor (it counters below 900). If deterministic coverage is desired, expose a test-only knob to seed a stubborn vendor floor, or unit-test the persistence branch directly in ai_service/server without going through discovery.

GET /api/missions/{id}/offers returns both ai_negotiation_preview (simulation=true) and vendor_email (simulation=false) offers side-by-side; downstream comparison/PO flows should always filter by simulation=false or explicit source to avoid picking a preview by mistake.
